name: Why didn't my home sell, and how can a relaunch help?

mainEntity.name: Why didn't my home sell, and how can a relaunch help?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homes typically don't sell due to a combination of factors, including incorrect pricing, poor marketing, inadequate staging, or unfavorable market conditions. A relaunch strategy addresses these issues by re-evaluating the property's value, implementing professional photography and virtual tours, and developing a targeted marketing plan. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution conducts a thorough market analysis and property assessment to identify the specific reasons your listing expired, offering a tailored plan to attract new buyers and achieve a sale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homes don't sell due to pricing, marketing, staging, or market conditions. A relaunch helps by re-evaluating these factors with a new strategy.
